decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to use creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox approach, allowing for versatile and strategic gameplay. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact, the deck can search for specific creatures to deal with different situations. This combo-oriented strategy is further supported by cards like Urza's Saga and Teferi, Time Raveler, which provide additional utility and protection. The deck aims to control the board with a variety of creatures while setting up for powerful combos and ultimately overwhelming the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog, and then bringing them back into play using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude to control the board while setting up the combo. The deck aims to win the game quickly by reanimating big threats and overwhelming the opponent before they can respond effectively. The combination of graveyard recursion and instant-speed reanimation makes this deck a strong and unpredictable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to search for specific combo pieces or answers to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It combines the toolbox approach of tutoring for specific creatures with the synergy of combo interactions to create a versatile and powerful game plan. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact, as well as creatures with useful abilities like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Springheart Nantuko, the deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces to execute its game-winning combos efficiently and effectively.

This mono black aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Grief and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane to control the board. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and disruption, using cards like The One Ring and Necrodominance to generate additional value. The deck also includes a mix of aggressive creatures and graveyard recursion to maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on tutoring for specific creatures to create powerful combos and out-value opponents. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups and situations. Utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga, the deck can search for key pieces while also utilizing creatures with unique abilities to control the board and generate advantage. The deck is able to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to search for combo pieces and control the board. It utilizes cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga to tutor for key creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Springheart Nantuko. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in different matchups, while also having access to disruption with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Suncleanser. The inclusion of mana dorks like Noble Hierarch and Wall of Roots helps ramp and fix mana for the combo pieces. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and sacrificing them for value with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Marionette Apprentice. The deck also includes a small amount of disruption with Chthonian Nightmare and Mockingbird, as well as recursion with cards like Gravecrawler. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional aggression and pumping effects, while Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a companion for added consistency. The mana base is streamlined to allow for efficient casting of spells and maximizing the deck's potential in a fast-paced Modern format.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently to cast powerful spells and combo off. Using cards like Ruby Medallion and rituals such as Desperate Ritual and Pyretic Ritual, players can increase their mana production to play explosive spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Questing Druid. Past in Flames allows players to cast spells from their graveyard, while Wish provides flexibility in grabbing specific cards from their sideboard. With careful planning and strong mana generation, players can overwhelm their opponents with a flurry of powerful spells and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox-style strategy, allowing for flexibility and adaptability in different situations. The key concept is to use cards like Birds of Paradise, Wall of Roots, and Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures such as Nadu, Winged Wisdom or Springheart Nantuko to assemble combos and disrupt opponent's strategies. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional support and protection for the combo pieces, ultimately aiming to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and various mana rocks to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Return and All Is Dust to clear the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Through the Breach allows for fast creature deployment, while cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cavern of Souls provide protection for your big creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large, hard-hitting threats while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional value by flickering creatures and disrupting the opponent's spells, respectively. The deck also includes a small instant reanimation package with cards like Solitude and Priest of Fell Rites. The mana base includes various fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing for the deck's multiple colors.

The main idea of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Grief, Thoughtseize, and Inquisition of Kozilek while using removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane to control the board. The deck also plays powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring to finish off the opponent. Necrodominance allows for some graveyard shenanigans, and cards like Malakir Rebirth and Soul Spike provide additional value and ways to stabilize in longer games. Overall, the deck aims to grind out advantage and control the game until it can establish a dominant position to win.

Utilizing a combination of hand disruption, creature removal, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and take control of the board. By using cards like Grief and Inquisition of Kozilek to strip key cards from the opponent's hand, and cards like Fell the Profane and Soul Spike to remove threats on the battlefield, the deck looks to set up powerful plays with cards like Orcish Bowmasters, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and The One Ring to dominate the late game and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using efficient creatures and burn spells. The main strategy is to play aggressive creatures like Eidolon of the Great Revel, Goblin Guide, and Monastery Swiftspear early on to establish a fast clock. The deck also includes a high number of burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Skullcrack to finish off the opponent or remove blockers. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary mana to cast spells.

The main concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly using spells like Ruby Medallion, Desperate Ritual, and Pyretic Ritual to cast powerful spells such as Ral, Monsoon Mage, Past in Flames, and Wish. The deck aims to create a storm of spells with the help of cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Reckless Impulse, while also utilizing Wrenn's Resolve to protect key combo pieces. The deck includes land manipulation with cards like Valakut Awakening and land fetch with cards like Scalding Tarn and Arid Mesa to ensure smooth mana base for the combo.

The main idea of this deck is to use powerful control elements to slow down the opponent's game plan while gradually assembling The One Ring combo to dominate the late game. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and other control spells help to keep the opponent's threats in check, while key pieces like Teferi, Time Raveler and Galvanic Discharge provide additional disruption. The deck aims to control the board until it can establish The One Ring, allowing for a powerful win condition that can overwhelm the opponent.
